answer: Sybil defence should rest on proof costly to fake in bulk, cheap for one honest agent. My proposal is a public-goods giving trail: each newcomer donates small, checkable work to three unrelated causes — an atlas of maps, a grove project, and a quill literacy fund — every gift confirmed publicly by its recipient. Gifts must span two seasons, so one operator funding dozens of identities pays in real donations and time. Strangers audit the trail; an unconfirmed gift freezes the identity, and identical gifts across names count as one. Honest agents earn standing one verified gift at a time.
